text: おれ　おかあさんに　たのんで　たんパンに　「タケシ」って　ししゅうを　してもらったよ！

structure.jp: おかあさんに　たのんで
たんパンに　「タケシ」って　ししゅうを　してもらったよ！
structure.en: had her embroider "Brock" on my shorts!

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: もらう after a て-form verb says you got someone to do it for you. ししゅうを　してもらった = 'I had it embroidered for me'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って here is the casual form of と and shows the exact words that the embroidery says. 「タケシ」って　ししゅう = 'embroidery that says "Brock"'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. たのんで = 'I asked, and'.
